test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
6 boys, J, K, L, M, N and P, are sitting around a rectangular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 4 boys are sitting in the corners, and 1 boy is sitting in the middle of each shorter side of the table. N is second to the right of K and second to the left of J. M is exactly opposite to N, and M is not sitting in the corner. 

Which of the following statements is definitely correct? 

I. L and P are both next to N. 

II. K is diagonally opposite to L.

options.text: Neither I nor II is correct.
Both I and II are correct.

solution:
Given: 6 boys, J, K, L, M, N and P, are sitting around a rectangular table facing towards the centre.

4 boys are sitting in the corners, and 1 boy is sitting in the middle of each shorter side of the table.
